subject: CTimer — per-frame timestep, game_FPS, pause flags, and the physics clamp
discovery_note: All addresses and constants proven by Capstone disassembly. External project names are never used as evidence. The clamp constant (2.0) proven from rdata 0x858C14 directly referenced by CTimer::Update at 0x560DA2.

globals.name: bIsFrozen
globals.note: Flag: non-zero stops time advance (loading, cutscene pause)

globals.name: bGameStarted
globals.note: Flag tested in CTimer::Update alongside bIsFrozen

globals.name: game_FPS
globals.note: Measured frames per second — written once per frame by CTimer::Update (fstp at 0x560F86)

globals.name: ms_fTimeStep_prev
globals.note: Previous frame's clamped timestep (ms_fTimeStep saved before update)

globals.name: ms_fTimeStepNonClipped
globals.note: Raw unclamped elapsed step. Used by rendering/interpolation that must not stutter. Set to fixed value 0x3C23D70A (~0.00795) when bIsFrozen=1.

globals.name: ms_fTimeStep
globals.note: Clamped per-frame step — the scalar multiplied 984× in .text. MAX = 2.0 proven from rdata 0x858C14 at 0x560DA2. Unit: 50ms per unit (1.0 = one 50ms tick). So 30fps → ~0.667, 60fps → ~0.333, 120fps → ~0.167. Max of 2.0 = ~100ms frame cap.

globals.name: ms_nTimeInMilliseconds
globals.note: Game-time accumulator in milliseconds — incremented every frame, compared against a threshold at 0x560D37 (fcomp [0x858C58])

ms_fTimeStep_max.meaning: If ms_fTimeStepNonClipped > 2.0, ms_fTimeStep is capped at 2.0. Prevents tunnelling through geometry on long stalls. Two units = 100ms at 50ms-per-unit.

ms_fTimeStep_min.meaning: Floor value for timestep — stops physics from running at zero when frames are impossibly fast.

notes: If bIsFrozen or !bGameStarted, sets ms_fTimeStepNonClipped to fixed 0x3C23D70A (~0.01s equivalent)
Clamps ms_fTimeStepNonClipped against rdata MIN floor (0x858B3C area)

modder_implications.fps_unlock_problem: At 60fps ms_fTimeStep ~0.333, at 120fps ~0.167. All velocities/forces multiply ms_fTimeStep, so doubling framerate halves each per-frame delta — physics is effectively correct. However some legacy code adds a per-frame constant without timestep scaling, causing speed-up at high FPS.
modder_implications.physics_cap_note: The 2.0 max means the engine never simulates more than ~100ms of physics in one frame. A stall longer than 100ms simply drops that extra time — objects do not teleport.
modder_implications.safe_patch_target: To adjust the cap, patch the float at rdata 0x858C14 (currently = 2.0 = 0x40000000). Increasing it widens the stall-protection window. Decreasing it creates artificial slowdown under load.
modder_implications.timestep_unit: ms_fTimeStep unit confirmed as 50ms per 1.0. Evidence: 0x3C23D70A ≈ 0.008 is the frozen value (~0.4ms), and 2.0 cap = 100ms max. Normal ~33ms frame → ~0.667.

ties.C51: CTimer::Update called inside CGame::Process every frame (C51.2)
ties.C42: ms_fTimeStep multiplied in every vehicle physics integration step
ties.C25: Object physics also multiplies ms_fTimeStep for velocity integration
ties.C41: CWanted task timers multiply ms_fTimeStep for their timeouts
